claims.content: Allow users to configure application preferences including password and keyfile settings for archiving operations.

goal.raw_text: Allow users to configure application preferences including password and keyfile settings for archiving operations.

claims.content: User
The PeaZip application is installed on the computer system.
The File Manager Interface is open and accessible to the user.
The User selects the Settings option from the application menu to open the Settings Interface.

trigger.raw_text: The User selects the Settings option from the application menu to open the Settings Interface.

claims.content: The User selects the 'Settings' option from the application menu, which opens the Settings Interface.
The system displays the 'General (1)' tab of the Settings Interface by default.
The User can navigate to different configuration categories using the tabs: General (1), General (2), Create archive, Open archive, Open with..., File tools, and Theming.
The User modifies desired parameters within the selected tab, such as Localization settings or Desktop path configurations.
The User clicks the 'Done' button to save the changes and close the Settings Interface.
The User selects the 'Tools' menu option from the File Manager Interface.
The User selects 'Enter password / keyfile' from the Tools submenu to configure encryption settings for an archive.
The User selects 'Create keyfile' from the Tools submenu to generate a new keyfile for use with archives.
The User clicks the 'Reset' button to revert all configuration changes made in the current session back to their default values.
The User clicks the 'Reset bookmarks' button to clear saved bookmark paths.
Application preferences have been updated and saved according to the user's configuration.
The Settings Interface is closed after the user clicks 'Done'.
